title: Minimum Path Cost in a Hidden Grid
summary: Explore an unknown weighted grid through GridMaster (canMove, move, isTarget) and return the minimum total cost from the start to the target, or -1 if unreachable. Movement cost depends on the entered cell.
inputFormat: No input grid: the GridMaster interface is the input.
edgeRules: The cost rule for entering a cell and the blocked-cell return value are not recorded.
factsMissing: Return value of move on a blocked or target cell
Cost range and whether blocked cells cost zero
questions: What does move(direction) return: the cost of the entered cell, and what for a blocked cell?
What are the cell cost range and grid limits?
